payload.name: Passport Photo Compress to 100KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup passport photo 100KB compressor with an optional one-contact USD 9 upload fix-plan request.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based passport photo compressor for 100KB application, visa, exam, school, and document upload limits. It works without an account or server upload and exposes a one-contact optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request for exact public-safe settings, fallback steps, and a review-before-upload checklist after fit is confirmed.
